subject: Meshpoint SIG/CAIQ sync — scheduling & evidence routing
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@meshpoint.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: olivia@meshpoint.com
Date: 2025-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Meshpoint security questionnaire sync

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for taking this. We just kicked off a SIG/CAIQ review internally and would like to schedule a 45-minute sync to walk through the questionnaire, confirm the evidence matrix, and align on delivery windows. Key asks from our side:
- Confirm who on Redwood will own each evidence item (logs, SOC attestation, CASB screenshots, architecture diagram)
- Clarify retention windows and sample logs (how far back can you provide extracts?)
- Secure transfer method for sensitive artifacts (SFTP preferred)

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2025-11-04 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2025-11-05 14:00–14:45

If those don't work, please suggest alternatives. We can loop in procurement once we lock timing and the artifact list.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Security Lead | Meshpoint
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@meshpoint.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Olivia Greene <olivia@meshpoint.com>
Date: 2025-11-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Meshpoint security questionnaire sync

Samir —

Appreciate the note. We can cover the CAIQ/SIG mapping and evidence routing in a 45-minute call. Confirming attendees from our side:
- Lauren Bishop — Security & Compliance Program Manager (I will lead)
- Marissa Cole — Security Operations (artifact handoff & access)
- David Kim — Compliance Engineer (SOC2 artifacts and control mapping)

The Tue 11/4 10:00 PST slot works for us. I've attached a short SOC2 overview and an initial evidence matrix template (meshpoint_evidence_matrix.xlsx) showing typical owners and delivery windows — we filled in likely owners where obvious, but we should review together.

Quick answers to your initial questions:
- Retention: We maintain 90-day hot logs and a 2-year archival policy (searchable snapshots on request); we can provide log extracts covering the last 90 days by default.
- Transfer: SFTP is fine. We'll provide credentials or a scoped, one-time upload link. See sftp_instructions.txt attached — Marissa will own the drop.

Agenda proposal for the call (45m):
1) 5m intro & scope
2) 15m walkthrough of CAIQ/SIG sections most relevant to Meshpoint (data residency, access controls, logging)
3) 15m evidence matrix review (owners + timelines)
4) 10m next steps & intake logistics (SFTP, drive, redaction requirements)

I'll send a calendar invite to lock the slot and add an intake link for you to populate any nonstandard evidence requests before the call.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@meshpoint.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: olivia@meshpoint.com, procurement@meshpoint.com
Date: 2025-11-02T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Meshpoint security questionnaire sync

Thanks, Lauren — 10:00 PST on Tue 11/4 is confirmed on our side.

A couple of clarifications ahead of the call so we can make the walk-through efficient:
- When you say "log extracts" — is that raw application logs or aggregated telemetry? We typically need raw events for a 30-day window for a transactional sample.
- For SOC2 artifacts: do you have a recent attest report (2024/2025) we can provisionally review prior to the call?

Procurement has been CC'd — they will review any additional NDA/PO items after our technical sync.

Samir
Security Lead | Meshpoint

Hi all —

Thanks for confirming the call. A few operational notes and links to make the intake smoother:
1) SFTP: We have a scoped intake bucket (sftp://files.redwood-inference.com/meshpoint-intake). Please do not upload PII without redaction. Attached sftp_instructions.txt includes credentials provisioning steps; we'll issue time-limited credentials after the call.
2) Evidence windows:
   - Logs: default 90-day hot extracts; transactional samples available for a 30-day window if you need raw event context. Please list specific time ranges in the intake form.
   - Architecture diagram: we can provide a sanitized high-level diagram; sensitive internal IPs will be redacted.
   - SOC2: we have a 2024 Type II report (PDF) — David, can you attach the report after the meeting?
3) Intake form: please complete the intake sheet at https://app.redwood-inference.com/evidence/intake/MP-2025-0911 before EOD 11/05 if you have any special requests. That helps us prep the right extracts.

Marissa
Security Operations
Redwood Inference
